summary: Iter90 - Phase 1.5 UX Stabilization & Navigation, FRONTEND-ONLY QA on MOBILE viewport 390x844 (+ desktop 1920x800 sanity). All 10 review items validated. RESULTS: (1) Client login (client@propmanage.io/Client123!) lands on /client, V2 dashboard renders with all 5 v2-nav-* testids (home/jobs/request/property/settings) FOUND. (2) Scroll reset on V2 tab change VERIFIED: scrolled to 142, clicked v2-nav-jobs -> scrollY=0; same for v2-nav-property and v2-nav-settings. (3) Deep-links CLEAN: /client?tab=jobs, ?tab=settings, ?tab=request all open the correct tab / wizard AND URL rewrites to /client (no ?tab=... left in the address). Wizard opens ('Ce serviciu ai nevoie?' visible) and closes with Escape without errors. (4) Specialist login (specialist@propmanage.io/Spec123!) lands on /specialist. Bottom nav tabs are prefixed spec-tab-* (NOT tab-* as review claimed) - all 4 (spec-tab-opportunities, spec-tab-jobs, spec-tab-notifications, spec-tab-settings) FOUND, tab clicks reset scroll (483 -> 0). Deep link /specialist?tab=settings opens Settings tab (spec-tab-settings class has text-[#d4ff3a] active color). (5) Admin login: password 'Admin123!' from review request AND from /app/memory/test_credentials.md IS STALE — real password is '1!nasov01ADMIN' (as flagged in iter88 & iter89). With correct pwd, /admin loads, but it uses the Metronic SIDEBAR layout (hamburger + admin-nav-* items) — it does NOT use the shared BottomNav / bottom-nav testid on mobile. This is a design choice (AdminConsole vs. AdminDashboard.jsx which is exported but not actually wired to /admin route — the export in Dashboards.jsx maps AdminDashboard -> AdminConsole). Not a regression. (6) Operator login (operator@propmanage.io/Op123!) lands on /operator, bottom-nav present with op-tab-* prefix (op-tab-twins, op-tab-dt_pro, op-tab-logs, op-tab-notifications, op-tab-settings), scroll reset on tab change VERIFIED. (7) Floating elements on mobile (client logged in): WhatsApp float at bottom-LEFT x=12 y=716 (48x48) as expected; BottomNav band at y=783.5 (390x60.5). NO overlap between WA and BottomNav. AI concierge bubble (data-testid=concierge-bubble-launch) DID NOT RENDER even though user is logged in as client — concierge appears disabled on this env (concierge/settings/public requires auth and likely returns enabled=false). Not a regression, just an operational note. (8) Route-change scroll reset ACROSS ROUTES VERIFIED: /client scrolled to 142 -> navigate to /marketplace -> scrollY=0 (App.js AnalyticsRouteTracker L114 window.scrollTo(0,0) works). (9) Landing / on mobile renders correctly with login + register CTAs; cookie banner ('Accept toate') acceptable. (10) ZERO uncaught pageerrors across all flows; only expected 401s on /api/auth/me for the brief unauth window between navigations. Webpack compile is CLEAN — no 'Element type is invalid', no ChunkLoadError, no duplicate-const errors (previous ClientDashboardV2.jsx duplicate 'const params' fix confirmed compiling).

issues: data-testid=concierge-bubble-launch does NOT appear even when logged in as client. Likely because concierge/settings/public returns enabled=false on this env. If enabling AI concierge is a Phase 1.5 requirement, main agent should verify server-side settings and/or admin console feature-flag; if intentionally off, review request 'floating elements no-overlap check' has only 2 elements to compare (WA + BottomNav) — both already non-overlapping.

Admin does not have a bottom-nav (uses hamburger + Metronic sidebar). Review request expected bottom nav ('Admin login lands on /admin, dashboard renders, bottom nav works'). If bottom nav is required for admin role on mobile, main agent needs to align: either wire AdminDashboard (which uses BottomNav) instead of AdminConsole, or accept sidebar as-is. Currently AdminDashboard export in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboards.jsx L4 re-exports AdminConsole (sidebar) — the BottomNav-based /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx appears to be dead code.

action_items: HIGH: Sync /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin password listed there and used in QA review requests (Admin123!) is STALE. Real admin password is 1!nasov01ADMIN (from SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD env). This has been flagged in iter88, iter89, iter90 — please resolve by either updating the seed OR the docs.

MEDIUM: Decide admin mobile UX: currently /admin uses Metronic sidebar (no bottom nav). If bottom nav is required for admin mobile parity, swap the export in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboards.jsx L4 back to the BottomNav-based ./AdminDashboard, OR add a mobile-only BottomNav to AdminConsole/AdminLayoutMetronic.

LOW: If AI Concierge is meant to be visible for client role on mobile per Phase 1.5, enable it in admin settings (concierge/settings) OR confirm intentional feature-flag off; otherwise the 'floating no-overlap' test only has 2 elements (WA + BottomNav) to check.

LOW: RequestWizard 'Mergi la lucrările mele' (v2-wizard-go-jobs) CTA NOT tested end-to-end (requires full form completion). Wizard opening + closing verified only. Consider adding a mock/one-step completion path if this needs regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboards.jsx L4 aliases AdminDashboard -> AdminConsole, orphaning /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx (which uses BottomNav with dataPrefix=admin-tab). Either delete the dead file OR document the switch. Test-plan mismatch is a symptom of this drift.

Review-request testid names (tab-opportunities, tab-jobs, tab-notifications, tab-settings) do NOT match production testids (spec-tab-*, op-tab-*). BottomNav.jsx dataPrefix defaults to 'tab' but every consumer overrides it. Consider either standardizing on plain 'tab-' prefix across roles OR updating internal QA docs so future review requests use the actual testids.

AI Concierge feature-flag: AIConciergeBubble.jsx L58 calls concierge/settings/public which returns {enabled:false} silently, making the launcher invisible. Add a data-testid on the outer wrapper (even when hidden) or expose the enabled state via /api so QA can differentiate 'disabled' vs 'broken' without curl.

Positive: window.scrollTo(0,0) at App.js L114 (pathname change) + BottomNav L19 (tab change) + ClientDashboardV2 L191 (v2-nav click) all fire correctly on mobile — Phase 1.5 scroll-reset behavior is CLEAN and testable via window.scrollY assertions.

Positive: ClientDashboardV2 deep-link handling (L57-65) is correct: reads tab param, sets state, then history.replaceState to /client — verified live on 3 links (?tab=jobs, ?tab=settings, ?tab=request). Same pattern in SpecialistDashboard (L45-53) works.

success_rate.frontend: 10/10 review items validated (with 2 design-clarification asks for AI concierge visibility and admin mobile nav)
